ActionDescriptions.ToFindAncestorInstructionFiles:
to find ancestor instruction files for a path
startPath - existing file or directory. fileName - one instruction filename, such as AGENTS.md. Returns nearest-first matching ancestor paths; does not read their content.
ActionDescriptions.ToVerifyClaimedFileHashes:
to verify claimed file hashes against actual bytes
directoryPath - existing base directory. claimedHashPairs - path=SHA256 claims separated by semicolons or newlines; absolute paths also allowed. Returns per-file Match/Mismatch/Missing and AllMatch. Empty or malformed claims fail explicitly.
